replies.author: Tarheelkiwi
replies.body:
I will make one up:

Once upon a time, there was a little kiwi who wanted to learn how to fly.  So he went to flight school where he was taught the basics of flight.  He practiced so hard, he went to bed exhausted.  One day, he decided to test this flight skills by climbing a mountain and jumping off.  He was able to glide, but when he tried to gain altitude, he ended up going into a nose dive and smacked onto the hard ground below.  It was safe to say, he didn't make it.  The doctors tired everything, but we unsuccessful.  His family decided to bury him at the sight where he jumped.  Legend has it that during the night, his spirit awakens and he continues to learn how to fly.  He also will haunts anyone who can fly or attempts and is successful. 

-Tarheelkiwi

replies.author: Tarheelkiwi
replies.body:
Now time for a real story.  HEHE
Note this is also fictional.  Characters in this story are completely made and the story itself should be taken literally!

Me and three other friends were going to hang out together.  We decided to meet at the local cemetery.  We brought snacks and drinks and hung out next to Henry Williams' grave.  We didn't know who he was, but we noticed that he died three years ago.  We thought it was funny to play around with the grave and said stuff like, "Oh you don' mind right Mr. Williams" "Is it OK that we stay here."  We were joking around and having a good time.  It was 12 p.m. when we decided to head home.  Right as we were packing up, my friend, Sara, said to the grave, "I wish you could come home with me."  We laughed and joked that Mr. Williams was coming with us.  A couple days later, Sara noticed some paranormal activity happening around her house.  Some of these events were, objects disappearing, doors shutting by themselves, lights coming on and off, and hearing spooky sounds like footsteps and even whispering.  She became very scared but didn't tell anyone.  The final straw was 2 a.m.  She and her family were sleeping when the t.v. came on.  The sound was all the way up and the show was Ghost Busters.  She had enough and called your boyfriend, Alex.  She told him about the creepy events and the t.v.  We all got together at Sara's house and tried something.  Since the ghost followed Sara when she wanted him to come home with her, we decided to try to get the ghost to follow her back to the grave.  We beckoned him to come.  When we arrived at his grave, we told Mr. Williams that he was home.  About a week passed and Sara nor any of us experienced any sort of paranormal activity.  Some paranormal detectives went to the grave and told us that Mr. Williams' spirit was still active.  We were very shocked to hear this.  We were just trying to be funny and never thought that the ghost was really going to follow us.  We learned our lesson, think before you act.

What did you guys think.  Spooky right.

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body: Peter Venkman, Ray Stantz, and Egon Spengler are three scientists at Columbia University in New York City. When their grant expires, the guys are fired and they go into business as a ghost extermination company called "Ghostbusters". Their first customer is orchestra cello player Dana Barrett, who was scared out of her apartment on the 22nd floor of a high rise apartment building on Central Park West. It seems that Dana's neighbor, Louis Tully, is also being affected by the strange happenings in the apartment building. Armed with proton guns, the Ghostbusters become wildly popular, and they are joined by Winston Zeddmore, who is looking for a job with good pay. Overzealous Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) agent Walter Peck thinks the Ghostbusters are frauds, and he has the Ghostbusters put in jail. Peck is forced to believe the Ghostbusters when New York City is put under siege by an ancient Sumerian God named Gozer the Gozerian, who is channeled through the apartment building that Dana and Louis live in, and the mayor has no choice but to let the Ghostbusters out of jail to face Gozer.
